{{Quote|You've heard of the third continent of Zarak-Nine? Created by one of my bombs, sunk into a fault line and detonated.|Kapp Zyman|<ref name="Derailing the Rocket Tram">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Derailing the Rocket Tram|Corellia}}</ref>}}
'''Zarak-Nine''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that originally had two continents, before a bomb designed by [[Kapp Zyman]] sunk into a fault line and detonated, causing an explosion that split off a new continent.<ref name="Derailing the Rocket Tram" />
